goal: Segregation of duties check: the author, reviewer and deployer of a change are different people.
use: Segregation of duties check: the author, reviewer and deployer of a change are different people. Use when a team sets roles for code, review and release.

steps.note: List the roles. Author, reviewer, approver and deployer.
Check conflicts. Flag people who hold conflicting roles on the same change.
Check the pipeline. Flag accounts that can merge and deploy with no review.
Check exceptions. Each exception needs an approval and an expiry.
Report. The conflicts, the affected changes and the fix.
